title: From ₹10 lakh crore to almost zero: India's bank cash squeeze, explained
short: From ₹10 lakh crore to almost zero: the bank cash squeeze
dek: Banks' spare cash has nearly vanished since September, pushing overnight rates above the repo rate. Why it happened, and why the RBI is now lending money back.
card: Bank liquidity fell from nearly ₹10 lakh crore in September to ₹542 crore on 22 October. A quieter tightening alongside the rate hike.
